```{=html}
<pre class="pseudocode" data-line-number="true">
\begin{algorithmic}
\Procedure{FibBottomUp}{$n$}
\If{$n\le1$}\State\Return $n$\EndIf
\State $dp[0]\gets0$; $dp[1]\gets1$
\For{$i\gets2$ \textbf{to} $n$}
\State $dp[i]\gets dp[i-1]+dp[i-2]$
\EndFor
\State\Return $dp[n]$
\EndProcedure
\end{algorithmic}
</pre>
```
